sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

This pump 
is located into the pits at the level of 63.5 and it's 
function is to dewater the unit and dewater the drainage water in the pit.

This document is initiated and tested by eng. Ahmed Abdel Qder Mahmoud, 
accepted by eng. Atty Seiffen general manager, and approved by eng. Mohamed 
Abd El Baset Ahmed Rekaby: Head Sector of Aswan Dam 1&2 PS and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category

Maintenance staff should will trained & qualified or directly supervised by 
 some one
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل

يجب استخدام معدات السلامة والصحة مثل خوذة الأمان وأحذية السلامة ... 
 إلخ.
يتم تجفيف الحفرة.

sections.text: الأدوات والمعدات
Torque wrenches,
Allen key, screw driver
Safety and healthy equipment
العمل المراد تنفيذه

Change 
 the oil

Change 
 the oil method: Lay the pump on the its side over two supports.

Remove 
 the screw الزيت وحلقة O من أحد 
 ثقوب النفط.

Turn the 
 pump so that the oil hole faces downwards and remove the other oil hole screw.

Replace 
 or fix worn and damaged parts.

Replacing the impeller: 
 Worn impeller often have very sharp edges and to replace it; 
 Remove nuts, impeller المسمار، و remove 
 the washer then pull off the impeller.

Installing the impeller: 
 Make sure that the end of the shaft is clean and free of burns, polish-off any 
 flaws.
قم بتنظيف وتزييت جميع الأسطح والحلقات.

Check the key is seated in the key way on the 
 shaft, grease end of the shaft and impeller hub, place washer on the impeller 
 screw, press the impeller on to the shaft with impeller screw and tight the 
 screw

Check that the impeller is firmly seated and 
 rotated by hand.
